notes.title: Demo Update: Bug Fixes & Tower Targeting System
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585579/a8d6f19f20bc15cfa23620ebbb9c7c581b36ab2e.png"]
Bug Fix – Nexus
Nexus can no longer be purchased twice.

New Sound
Added: Craft Black By Hand.

Unit Teleportation
Units no longer teleport backwards when stuck, but to the side.

Tower Targeting System
The old tower always targets the enemy that is closest to it.
The new tower, on the other hand, first focuses on the position of its last shot and looks for a new target there. However, if another unit comes too close to the tower, it immediately turns to it and attacks instead. This way, it doesn’t waste as much time rotating.
Click here for video

Game Start Changes
At the beginning of the game, you now only start with 2 blocks, and the first tower costs nothing.

Bug Fix – First Tower Quest
When starting the first wave, then finishing it and destroying a tower afterwards, you got stuck in the quest: "buy first tower".

Demo Feature
You can now delete or load your save file (but only one save file in total, demo only).

Localization Fix
ToString was localized so that numbers no longer display differently depending on system language.
For example, someone’s cooldown showed as 0.173194184 sec instead of 0.173, because their language settings caused the ToString function to format numbers differently.

Visual Update 
- Energy bar redesigned.
- Stones redesigned.

Settings Note
In the settings it now says that you can press F11 to toggle fullscreen (though this was already possible before).

Security Update
Security for theft protection expanded.

notes.title: Demo Update: Fresh UI, Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585579/535c7337f2ca9620c0dedd5257240655781037ce.png"]

Tower Behavior Fix (Sniper / Shotgun / Smelter)

Previously, towers often rotated back and forth by 180° after each shot, wasting time instead of focusing on enemies.

Now, before firing, a tower checks where it last shot. If an enemy is still there, it will keep shooting in that direction, reducing unnecessary spinning.

 

Demo Fix

You can now load the old demo saves again.

 

Shop

The shop has been redesigned to make placing towers much faster and more seamless.

 

Unlock Animation

Many players didn’t understand that unlocking a tower doesn’t automatically give it. This animation now shows the lock breaking to clarify that the tower still needs to be purchased afterwards.

 

Quest System Update

Quests are now saved with their names as strings, making them easier to edit in future updates.

 

Bug Fix: Flying Text

Flying text no longer appears when buying a building.

 

Spawn Zone Progression

Instead of moving back every 5 levels, the spawn zone now shifts every level.

 

New Message

If the player tries to buy a building while a wave is running, a warning message will appear.

 

Demo Call to Action

At the end of the demo, and also in the main menu, players are now prompted to wishlist the full game so they won’t miss the release, and they can also join the official Discord server. Thanks for all the feedback! The next update is already in the works :)
